'''''Gomphocarpus fruticosus''''' (swan plant; narrow-leaved cotton bush) is a species of [[plant]] native to [[South Africa]].<ref>Clive Bromilow; Problem Plants of South Africa, Briza Publications 2001 {{ISBN|1-875093-27-3}}</ref> It is also common in Australia and New Zealand where it is a host of the [[monarch butterfly]].<ref>Multiple sources:
* {{cite journal|last1=Wise|first1=K. A. J.|author-link1=Keith Arthur John Wise|date=June 1963|url=https://nzetc.victoria.ac.nz/tm/scholarly/tei-Bio11Tuat02-t1-body-d5.html|title=Food-Plants of 'Monarch' Butterfly Larvae|journal=Tuatara|volume=11|number=2|pages=81-82|location=[[Wellington|Wellington, New Zealand]]|publisher=[[Victoria University of Wellington]]|access-date=March 7, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231130120728/https://nzetc.victoria.ac.nz/tm/scholarly/tei-Bio11Tuat02-t1-body-d5.html|archive-date=November 30, 2023|url-status=live}}
* {{cite web|url=https://weedsofmelbourne.org/narrow-leaved-cotton-bush-gomphocarpus-fruticosus|title=Narrow-leaved Cotton Bush (''Gomphocarpus fruticosus''|work=Weeds of Melbourne|date= March 30, 2021|access-date=March 7, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230929004235/https://weedsofmelbourne.org/narrow-leaved-cotton-bush-gomphocarpus-fruticosus|archive-date=September 29, 2023|url-status=live}}</ref> The plant's tissues contain sufficient [[cardenolides]] that consumption of significant quantities of the plant's leaves, stems, or fruit may lead to death in livestock and humans.<ref>Van Wyk, Van Oudshoorn & Gerike: Medicinal plants of South Africa, Briza Publications 1997. {{ISBN|1-875093-09-5}}</ref><ref name="PHQ2012">{{cite web|author=Philip H. Quanjer |title=Milk Weed ''Asclepias fruticosa'' |url=http://www.focusonpictures.com/zuidafrika/bloemen/bloemen8.htm |accessdate=10 January 2014}}</ref><ref name="Wagstaff 2008">p. 36 in {{cite book|author=D. Jesse Wagstaff|title=International Poisonous Plants Checklist, An Evidence-Based Reference|publisher=CRC Press, Boca Raton, Fla.|year=2008|isbn=9781420062533|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=h7tbd-5ZAQ8C&q=Asclepias+fruticosa+poisoning&pg=PA36}}</ref>

The plant, also referred to as ''Narrow leaf cotton bush'', has officially been declared a pest in [[Western Australia]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.agric.wa.gov.au/declared-plants/narrow-leaf-cotton-bush-declared-pest |title=Narrow leaf cotton bush: declared pest |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=4 May 2020 |website=agric.wa.gov.au |publisher=Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development |access-date=7 May 2021 |quote=Narrow leaf cotton bush (Gomphocarpus fruticosus) is a declared pest in Western Australia (WA). |archive-date=7 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210507142551/https://www.agric.wa.gov.au/declared-plants/narrow-leaf-cotton-bush-declared-pest |url-status=dead }}</ref>

The species is closely related to ''[[Gomphocarpus physocarpus]]''.
